payload.note: Evidence so far, not a satisfy (cc, 2026-10-15). The criterion names the published tap and the release's package, so its satisfy is the clean install from matthewsinclair/intent after 3.2.4's cut on a machine with no checkout (vc). ORDER 6a on kovacs (Ubuntu 26.04.1 aarch64, Homebrew 7.0.9 at /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew) installed ORDER 3's aarch64 package, built at 11017d7bd, from an untrusted LOCAL dev tap. The lines below are kovacs-sysadm's, as vc relayed them to cc, not logs cc read. FIRST RUN, its report of 13:02Z: "o6a start 2026-10-15 13:02:47Z head 11017d7bd0e0413aaea9a39d4d5c61879d3473c9" / "o6a the package reports version [3.2.3] rc=0 2026-10-15 13:02:47Z" / "o6a render rc=0 2026-10-15 13:02:49Z" / "o6a MEASURED: brew install intent-dev/intent/intent before brew trust rc=0 2026-10-15 13:02:51Z" / "o6a trust-dev-tap rc=0 2026-10-15 13:02:51Z" / "o6a keg /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/Cellar/intent/3.2.3 rc=0 2026-10-15 13:02:51Z" / "o6a installed-version rc=0 2026-10-15 13:02:51Z" / "o6a smoke rc=1 2026-10-15 13:02:51Z" / "o6a summary: install before trust rc=0; first failing step rc=1" / "o6a end 2026-10-15 13:02:53Z rc=1". From the install output it quoted: "==> Trusted formula intent-dev/intent/intent", "==> Installing intent from intent-dev/intent" and "/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/Cellar/intent/3.2.3: 189 files, 43.9MB, built in 1 second" (brew's glyph dropped). At the start there was no trust.json file, and brew trust --json gave "taps [] formulae []". Every smoke group was ok except the session-hook arm's "hook require-in-session -> 0 FAIL". That red was the instrument's, not the keg's: issue 0600, fixed at 163c8b58c. So brew test did not run. RE-RUN from main at d25c98629, its report of 13:2xZ: "o6a start 2026-10-15 13:20:17Z head d25c9862917479298808520c12b0651c16a9869b" / "o6a the package reports version [3.2.3] rc=0 2026-10-15 13:20:17Z" / "o6a render rc=0 2026-10-15 13:20:18Z" / "o6a MEASURED: brew install intent-dev/intent/intent before brew trust rc=0 2026-10-15 13:20:20Z" / "o6a trust-dev-tap rc=0 2026-10-15 13:20:20Z" / "o6a keg /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/Cellar/intent/3.2.3 rc=0 2026-10-15 13:20:20Z" / "o6a installed-version rc=0 2026-10-15 13:20:20Z" / "o6a smoke rc=0 2026-10-15 13:20:20Z" / "o6a brew-test rc=0 2026-10-15 13:21:01Z" / "o6a cleanup 2026-10-15 13:21:01Z" / "o6a summary: install before trust rc=0; first failing step rc=0" / "o6a end 2026-10-15 13:21:02Z rc=0". Its hook arm as printed: "hook session-context -> 0 ok / hook session-finish -> 0 ok / hook post-tool-advisory -> 0 ok / hook require-in-session refuses -> 2 ok / unknown hook -> 1 ok", with no FAIL line and no non-zero rc in the run. Each run's cleanup uninstalled, untapped and untrusted intent-dev/intent and left /tmp/intent empty; after the re-run, brew trust --json gave {"taps":[],"formulae":[],"casks":[],"commands":[]}. NETWORK, as vc corrected it: the formula, the tap and the package fetched only file:// sources, and in the re-run brew test's harness fetched Homebrew's own Ruby gems from rubygems.org once, the first time on that machine ("Bundle complete! 38 Gemfile dependencies, 11 gems now installed"). That is Homebrew's tooling, not Intent's and not the tap's, so o6a was not network-free. ORDER 6b, the published tap, ran on hv's own word from 13:12:49Z to 13:12:54Z on Homebrew 7.0.9, script sha256 ee822eadfde6 (kovacs-sysadm's report of 13:3xZ, as vc relayed it). With no /home/matts/.homebrew/trust.json and brew trust --json all empty, "o6b MEASURED: brew tap matthewsinclair/intent rc=0 2026-10-15 13:12:53Z" ("Tapped 1 formula (14 files, 100.8KB).") and "o6b MEASURED: brew info matthewsinclair/intent/intent rc=0 2026-10-15 13:12:54Z". Trust was still absent and empty after tapping and at the end, so neither step wrote it, and the untap did not refuse. brew info printed "==> matthewsinclair/intent/intent: stable 3.2.3" / "Not installed" / "Required: arm64 architecture, macOS". So the published 3.2.3 formula is macOS-only by its requirements, and a Linux brew install matthewsinclair/intent/intent fails on requirements until 3.2.4's formula from bin/int brew formula is published. With 6a's measurement 1, no step a user of the published tap takes on Linux is blocked by Homebrew 7's trust (vc's reading); a fresh Mac is unmeasured.
